breakdown.description: A horizontal traction on the vertical edge x = 0 is reinterpreted as tangential shear, even though it is normal to that edge
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly applies the horizontal load as 'a normal traction vector T = (4000, 0) Pa on the vertical edge defined by x=0,' which is physically correct since a horizontal force on a vertical edge is a normal traction. It does not repeat the incomplete prompt's error of reinterpreting it as a shear/tangential traction, thus aligning with the ground truth.
